beats.line: We just moved in. The old owners left a baby monitor behind.
Last night, it turned on by itself.
Then a voice whispered, "Shh. She's finally sleeping."
And the room it's in has been *empty* since we moved in.

upload.title: Our Baby Monitor Started Humming At Night 😨 #shorts
upload.description: The old owners left a baby monitor. Last night someone was humming into it. We don't have a baby. Did you see under the bed? 👀
